name: reveal
description: A hidden entity here becomes known to the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of an entity listed as hidden here.

name: enter
description: A cast member comes into the scene.

entity_id.description: Exact id of a cast member not already here.

name: leave
description: A cast member goes out of the scene.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who here died.

name: join_party
description: A character here starts travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who is joining.

name: leave_party
description: A party member stops travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the party member leaving.

name: next_scene
description: Call this with nothing set when the scene reaches a stopping point. Set `pursuit` instead once the player has left this place. Set `complication` instead to bring a new situation down on this place.

pursuit.description: Where the player is going, in their own words. Empty to offer the way on.

complication.description: What arrives or turns here, and why. Empty otherwise.

name: hire
description: Call this when the player hires someone here to work. Someone already travelling with the player can be hired too. The worldsmith writes their sheet once the turn ends. Nothing more lands this turn. A sheet is for someone hired to work, never for one who only comes along.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who here signs on.

terms.description: What they are hired for, and on what terms, as agreed.

name: drop_item
description: The actor loses an item for good.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item the actor carries.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: change_stress
description: The actor's stress goes up or down.

amount.description: How much stress changes. Positive costs stress, negative clears it.

why.description: What causes the change, in a few words.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: use_med_kit
description: The actor spends their med kit.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: roll
description: Call this for an action with a real cost. Roll one thing: a skill, a carried item, or a stunt. The engine rolls, reads the result, and wears the die down.

what.description: The attempt, in a few words the player reads.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

skill.description: Which of the six skills the action calls on.

item_id.description: Exact id of a carried item used instead of a skill.

stunt.description: True for an extraordinary stunt at d12.

dangerous.description: True when a fail would plainly hurt the actor.

helped_by.description: Exact id of a hired member who checks the same skill. Only with `skill`.

name: catch_breath
description: Call this after a lull in the danger. The engine resets the actor's skills, loot die and stunt, and brings a new complication.

actor_id.description: Exact id of a hired party member here who acts. Null for the player.

name: loot_check
description: Call this to scavenge for an item. The engine rolls the loot die and asks the player what to do with a find.

item.description: What is found if the roll finds anything.

name: test_luck
description: Call this to ask about the world when nobody acts. The engine rolls the die you pick and reads it.

question.description: A closed question about the world where nobody is acting.

die.description: Which die to roll, picked by the odds.
